items: The manager asked Ms. Lee to ____ the training session because the original instructor was unavailable.
'Conduct' means to organize and lead an activity such as a training session.
Please ____ the attached document carefully before signing the agreement.
The airline will ____ passengers by e-mail if the departure time changes.
'Notify' means to formally inform someone of something.
The board decided to ____ the proposal until additional cost data became available.
'Postpone' means to delay an event or decision until a later time.
The new software should ____ employees to process orders more quickly.
'Enable' means to make it possible for someone to do something.
The supervisor will ____ that all safety checks are completed before production begins.
'Ensure' means to make certain that something happens.
The consultant ____ the client that the revised schedule was realistic.
'Assured' means told someone confidently in order to remove doubt.
The company decided to ____ the warehouse against fire and flood damage.
'Insure' means to provide insurance coverage for property or risk.
Sales increased ____ after the company introduced online ordering.
'Considerably' is the adverb meaning by a large amount.
The committee reached a ____ decision after reviewing all three bids.
'Unanimous' describes a decision supported by everyone involved.
The manager asked employees to keep personal items ____ from the emergency exit.
'Away from' means at a distance from something.
The new branch is ____ located near two major railway stations.
'Conveniently' modifies 'located' and means in a location that is easy to use or reach.
The factory must ____ with all local environmental regulations.
'Comply with' means to act according to a rule or requirement.
The report will ____ the results of the customer survey and the sales analysis.
'Contain' means to include something within it; the report contains the results.
The annual conference will ____ of three workshops and a keynote address.
'Consist of' is the correct expression for stating the components of something.
The committee is ____ of representatives from five regional offices.
'Be composed of' means be made up of particular members or parts.
The supplier offered to ____ the defective parts at no additional cost.
'Replace' means to provide a new item in place of a defective one.
The technician was able to ____ the missing file from the backup server.
'Recover' means to retrieve something that was lost or inaccessible.
The company plans to ____ its customer-support team by hiring six additional agents.
'Expand' means to increase the size or scope of something.
The deadline was ____ by one week because several documents arrived late.
Please ____ your employee identification card when entering the secure area.
'Present' means to show or provide something for inspection.
The revised policy will take ____ on October 1.
The fixed expression is 'take effect', meaning become operative.
Rising fuel prices may ____ the company's distribution costs.
'Affect' is a verb meaning to influence something.
The marketing campaign had a positive ____ on online sales.
'Effect' is a noun meaning a result or influence.
The office will remain closed ____ Monday because of building maintenance.
'Through Monday' means continuing up to and including Monday.
